cards.card_text: Then the crowd runs down where they're all from: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, folks from Mesopotamia to Egypt, visitors from Rome, both Jews and converts to Judaism, Cretans and Arabs.
cards.verse_text: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia, Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome, both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”

cards.card_text: Then come Philip (not the apostle Philip), Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
cards.verse_text: They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, as well as Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
cards.snippet: …Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

cards.card_text: After the synagogue is dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism follow Paul and Barnabas.
cards.verse_text: After the synagogue was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.

cards.card_text: Then Paul brings up something the Galatians have already heard about: his former way of life in Judaism.
cards.verse_text: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.
cards.snippet: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy…

cards.card_text: Paul describes himself back in Judaism.
cards.verse_text: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
cards.snippet: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions…

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says that in Judaism he was falling behind most of the people his own age.
